transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for joining this renewal meeting. As you know, the manufacturing company has requested renewal of its $10 million revolving credit line for another twelve months, with the current facility expiring in sixty days. The submitted financials show stable annual revenue and positive operating cash flow. Before I record the final renewal decision and set the facility conditions, I'd like to hear from each of you — credit risk, legal, and relationship management — on any matters that should affect the final terms. Please go ahead.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I should note one important item from my side. I confirmed with the company's treasurer yesterday that the company will maintain a minimum operating deposit of exactly $1,200,000 throughout the renewed facility. This concession was agreed in a client call but has not yet been formally added to the renewal request. I believe this deposit commitment should be reflected in the final facility conditions.
